_doc: Pixel budgets per box/field for the VWF font (fonts/vwf8.txt). Script lines and dialogue-window code strings: width = tools/engine.py width(); list windows and centred labels: engine.list_width() (ASCII without window spacing). measured = seen in a zoomed shot with an exact-width test line (tools/widthtest.py, '|' marks the last column); 'min' = this width fits, larger not yet tried; inferred = the string was not drawn in a tour, its window comes from the pointer table it shares with drawn strings (tools/debug/drawmap.py, work/qa/drawmap/map.tsv). docs/re/vwf.md

dialogue.applies: script lines (MswStr): line 0 speaker label, lines 1-2 text; narration boxes use all 3 lines
dialogue.proof: work/qa/wt2/f002456.png: '192 px ... |' on lines 1 and 2 fully visible (last column x=214, frame from 218); 196 px clips; the page arrow sits in the frame (x 224-232), not over line 2

arm_name.applies: records.json *.name (ÄRM list, ÄRM deck, shops); also byte limit max (33)
arm_name.proof: work/qa/scenes/menu_deck_edit.png (build/widthtest.gba): '112 MWMW...|' ends 1-2 px before the cost digits (x 165); name starts x 52

arm_desc.applies: records.json *.desc (ÄRM deck info box, item box, status box); byte limit max (33)
arm_desc.proof: work/qa/scenes/menu_deck_edit.png: '150 MWMW...|' fits in the info box (text x 52, box edge ~205); status box starts further right (x ~52 after the portrait) - recheck >150 there

code._doc: code.json strings by window. ids = code.json ids; px = text budget; pad_to = the build pads the string with pad bytes ({pN}) to exactly this width so the numbers the game appends line up; bytes = max encoded bytes incl. pads (row buffers of 25 bytes hold label + digits + NUL); renderer from drawmap: dlg = dialogue-window path (engine.width), list/ctr = list windows / centred label (engine.list_width).

keep.applies: fullwidth digits ０-９, ／, blank 　 and －－－－: the status and ÄRM-list code copies 2 bytes per digit into its row buffers, so these stay 2-byte glyphs (en = jp)
keep.proof: work/qa/drawmap/menu_status/log.txt: row buffers hold '[c[c[c35]' (2 bytes of each digit string)

status_left.applies: STATUS left column labels LV./HP/attack/defence/magic; the game appends the digits ('99', '999/999', '255') to the label in a 25-byte row buffer
status_left.proof: original work/qa/orig/menu_status: label cells from x 8 (9-px cells), digits from x 44, HP row ink ends x 104, divider x 118: pad_to 40 puts digits at 48, HP row end at 111; widthtest work/qa/scenes/menu_status.png: '38 MW .|' + digits on every row, clear of the divider

status_exp.applies: STATUS 'EXP   NEXT' header over the 00000/99999 row (one string; pad with {pN} to put NEXT over the second number, which starts at x 62 + 1)
status_exp.proof: work/qa/orig/menu_status: row from x 8, divider x 118; widthtest work/qa/scenes/menu_status.png: '104 MW..|' ends x 111

status_elem.applies: STATUS element column (thunder/earth/wind/wood/fire/water) left of the 3-digit value
status_elem.proof: work/qa/orig/menu_status: label from x 152, digits '100' after 2 cells (x 170-196), portrait frame x 208: pad_to 26 ends the digits at 205; widthtest work/qa/scenes/menu_status.png: '24 ..|100' clear of the frame

status_equip.applies: STATUS bottom box header over the equipped ÄRM name
status_equip.proof: widthtest work/qa/scenes/menu_status.png: '150 MW...|' in the bottom box, ends x ~213

names.applies: party names in the menu/status/deck name tab (right-aligned in a 7-cell field via the pxlen hook) and party lists
names.proof: work/qa/scenes/menu.png, menu_deck.png, menu_item.png (widthtest): '40 MW ..|' in the COMMAND name tab (x 147, room to ~235). The STATUS-screen corner tab name is a sprite graphic (graphics survey), not this string

arm_type.applies: ÄRM class in the deck info box line 1, followed directly by the element (arm_element): 'Weapon ÄRM/' + 'No element' must fit 150 together
arm_type.state: measured min (sum with arm_element = arm_desc box)
arm_type.proof: widthtest work/qa/scenes/menu_deck_edit.png: '84 MWMWMWMW |66 MWMWM ...|' fits the info box line 1

arm_element.applies: element after the ÄRM class in the deck info box line 1
arm_element.state: measured min (sum with arm_type = arm_desc box)

area.applies: AREA SELECT name under the world map, centred in the 128-px box (x 55-183) via the pxlen hook
area.proof: work/qa/orig/world_map: box border x 54 and 184; work/qa/wt_wm (widthtest): '124 MWMW..|' centred inside the box

get.applies: 'P GET!!' / '%s GET!!' / 'but could not carry it' centred at x 128 on the battle WIN screen
get.proof: work/qa/wt_bw/f003900.png (widthtest, battle_win): banner text visible x 28-216, centred at x 128, so 176 px max; composed: code:087528 follows the gold amount in fullwidth digits (up to 5 x 9 px), code:087538's %s is an item/ÄRM name (arm_name, up to 112 px): its own text <= 60 px

deck_info.applies: 'nothing here' line in the deck info box (list) / an empty list
deck_info.state: code:0887f4 measured (drawmap menu_deck_edit@4980, deck info box = arm_desc); code:088e6c inferred

sort_headers.applies: number/cost/class/element/name: ÄRM sort keys (screen not toured)
sort_headers.state: guess: screen not reached; keep short until measured

messages.applies: shop/engraver/item/deck/link/save messages and menu help, drawn in a dialogue-type window (one line each; some are composed: a number or name is put in front, e.g. '200 ' + 'P, please.')

composed.code:08871c: after the price in fullwidth digits + space (work/qa/wt_shop/f002040.png: '２００ ' + text): <= 144 px
composed.code:0886c8: after the price, as code:08871c: <= 144 px

messages.proof: work/qa/wt_menu/final.png (widthtest, menu help '192 ...|' fully visible after the T0000-space fix); work/qa/wt_shop/f002040.png (price line; the overflow past 192 px lands on the next tile row)
messages.state: measured for the drawn ones (menu help c75 c79-c82, shop price c63: dlg path = dialogue window 192 px); the rest inferred from their pointer tables (0x1B0864-0x1B0914 shop/engraver/item/menu, 0x1BECEC deck, 0x1BF224-0x1BF264 link, 0x1BF3B0-0x1BF3CC save)
